hero.badge: EUV Program IS · Engineering Resource Management
hero.title: Engineering Operation Board
hero.subtitle: Unified platform for worklog tracking, resource forecasting, and milestone management — replacing scattered SharePoint & Excel workflows.
hero.author: Gerald Park

why.title: Why We Built This
why.subtitle: Engineering managers relied on scattered tools — SharePoint lists, Excel trackers, email chains — making resource visibility and reporting a constant pain.

scattered.title: Scattered Data
scattered.description: Worklogs in Excel, resource plans in SharePoint, project info in email. No single source of truth for engineering operations.

manual.title: Manual Tracking
manual.description: Monthly FTE reporting required hours of manual data collection and spreadsheet manipulation across multiple files.

visibility.title: Limited Visibility
visibility.description: No real-time view of team capacity, project allocation, or resource conflicts. Decisions based on outdated snapshots.

what.title: How It's Built
what.subtitle: A modern full-stack application designed for the engineering organization's specific workflows and data structures.

portal.title: Unified Portal
portal.desc: Single entry point to EOB, OQC, Jarvis, and other engineering services.

dashboard.title: Dashboard
dashboard.desc: Real-time charts, heatmaps, and AI weekly summaries for engineering visibility.

resourceMatrix.title: Resource Matrix
resourceMatrix.desc: Monthly FTE allocation view with scenario-based capacity monitoring.

api.title: REST API
api.desc: Layered architecture API server. SSO authentication and role-based access control.

classification.title: Cost Classification Engine
classification.desc: Priority-ordered rules auto-classify timesheet entries into cost buckets.

schema.title: Organization & Project Hierarchy
schema.desc: Hierarchical management of organizational structure and project structure.

dimensions.title: Financial Dimensions
dimensions.desc: Funding entities, IO, activity codes, and cost buckets for inter-company cost tracking.

sync.title: Data Sync
sync.desc: Data integration pipeline with external systems and automated backups.

deploy.title: One-Click Deploy
deploy.desc: Automated deployment pipeline for build, upload, and restart.

server.title: Production Server
server.desc: SSL termination, reverse proxy, and container-based operations.

how.title: What It Does
how.subtitle: Six key capabilities that transform how the engineering organization tracks work, plans resources, and manages projects.

worklog.title: Smart Worklog Tracking
worklog.description: Daily time entry with AI-powered natural language parsing. Heatmap visualization and weekly summaries generated automatically.

resource.title: FTE Resource Planning
resource.description: Monthly allocation matrix with scenario planning. TBD positions for future hiring. Sum-per-user constraint enforced by database trigger.

project.title: Project & Milestone Management
project.description: Track NPI, ETO, and support projects through PCP gates (G3→G5→G6). Internal IO and recharge IO mapping for cost tracking.

financial.title: Financial Classification
financial.description: Auto-classify work into cost buckets (Direct Product, Direct Project, Indirect, Overhead) with inter-company recharge logic across VSS, SUN, and LOCAL_KR.

reports.title: Plan vs Actual Reports
reports.description: Compare planned FTE against actual worklogs at department, project, and user levels. Monthly variance heatmaps and recharge reports.

ai.title: AI-Powered Summaries
ai.description: Weekly team activity summaries generated by Atlas Copco AIBrain (GPT-5). Cached for fast retrieval with period alignment.

benefits.title: Measurable Results
benefits.subtitle: Concrete improvements in how the engineering team operates, measured from pilot deployment.

reporting.label: Reporting Time
reporting.description: Monthly FTE reports generated in minutes instead of days of manual Excel manipulation.

visibility.label: Data Currency
visibility.description: From 2-3 week data lag to live dashboards with daily worklog updates.

tools.label: Tool Consolidation
tools.description: Single platform replaces SharePoint, Excel, email chains, and manual trackers.

accuracy.label: Classification Accuracy
accuracy.description: Rule-based engine auto-classifies timesheet entries. Low-confidence items flagged for review.

singleSource.title: Single Source of Truth
singleSource.description: All engineering resource data — worklogs, allocations, project milestones — in one unified database.

selfService.title: Self-Service Reporting
selfService.description: Managers generate their own reports instead of waiting for data requests. Real-time dashboards always available.

compliance.title: Financial Compliance
compliance.description: Automated cost classification and recharge tracking ensure consistent GL coding across all engineering work.

scalable.title: Scalable Architecture
scalable.description: Dockerized deployment with SSO integration. Ready to onboard additional teams and business units.

worklogs.after: Web app with AI natural language input

resource.after: Interactive FTE matrix with scenario planning

next.title: What's Next
next.subtitle: Planned enhancements to expand coverage and deepen analytical capabilities.

phase1.label: Phase 1 — Active
phase1.title: Core Platform
phase1.description: Worklog tracking, resource planning, project management, financial classification, AI summaries. Currently serving the EUV Program IS team.

phase2.label: Phase 2 — Planned
phase2.title: Advanced Analytics
phase2.description: Trend analysis, predictive resource forecasting, automated variance alerts, and enhanced plan-vs-actual reporting.

phase3.label: Phase 3 — Planned
phase3.title: Multi-Team Expansion
phase3.description: Onboard additional engineering teams. Cross-team resource sharing, consolidated dashboards, and unified recharge reporting.

phase4.label: Phase 4 — Future
phase4.title: AI-Driven PLM Expansion
phase4.description: Potential expansion into Product Lifecycle Management capabilities with AI-powered decision automation.

considerations.title: Key Considerations
items: Data migration strategy for teams transitioning from existing SharePoint workflows
SSO/SAML configuration for each Edwards subsidiary and business unit
Recharge IO mapping rules per business unit require finance team alignment
Classification rule tuning based on accumulated worklog patterns
